_doc: namecheck.py warnings that were looked at and kept. fr_sync and translit entries pin the names, so a later change on either side warns again. Keys: kind:CONSTANT (fr_sync, translit) and the English name (dupes).

species:SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.why: names follow FireRed (DECISIONS Q140), but FireRed's spelling does not fit: the Alolan form must be the base name + -א (Q129), and אקזגקיוטור-א is 52 px in the 50 px party and Pokédex lists and the 48 px healthbox (English 44 px)

move:MOVE_SLASH.why: FireRed's חיתוך is already MOVE_CUT in H&S (FireRed has the same duplicate), and two moves cannot share a name; שיסוף also matches NIGHT SLASH שיסוף לילי and AIR SLASH שיסוף אוויר (DECISIONS Q140)

item:ITEM_CHESTO_BERRY.why: a slip in FireRed: the English CHESTO has no R, and FireRed's צ'סטרו adds one (DECISIONS K6, Q140)

item:ITEM_IAPAPA_BERRY.why: the berry tag holds 6 bytes, so the stem is יאפאפה in both trees (FireRed src/berry.c too); H&S writes the bag name with the tag's stem so the two match (DECISIONS K6); FireRed's bag name differs from its own tag (Q140)

item:ITEM_POKEBLOCK_CASE.why: FireRed writes the {POKEBLOCK} token first for its own renderer; H&S keeps the reading order (STYLE §5, DECISIONS Q140)

item:ITEM_POKE_BALL.why: the owner's decision for H&S: POKé BALL is פוכדור, its plural פוכדורים, in every line and name (DECISIONS Q159)

trainer_class:TRAINER_CLASS_ELITE_FOUR.why: FireRed's full spelling עילית is 13 bytes; a trainer class name holds 12 (include/data.h u8 name[13]); FireRed widened its array for it, which in H&S is an engine change (DECISIONS Q140)

move:MOVE_PSYCHO_BOOST.why: Psychic is על-חושי in every name (DECISIONS Q139), the PSYCHO moves too; FireRed renamed its type and its PSYCHIC move but left this name on the old word

ability:ABILITY_STATIC.why: the owner's decision for H&S: an ability is named after היכולת in battle lines (Q162), and the bare adjective סטטי read as the word static there; חשמל סטטי is the phenomenon, as the Pokédex texts say (DECISIONS Q164)

ability:ABILITY_STURDY.why: a bare adjective, and the first name Eitan, after היכולת (Q162); איתנות is its noun (DECISIONS Q165)

ability:ABILITY_LIMBER.why: a bare masculine adjective after the feminine היכולת (Q162); גמישות is its noun (DECISIONS Q165)

ability:ABILITY_OBLIVIOUS.why: תמים is a bare adjective meaning naive, and in H&S also the nature NAIVE, which the summary shows beside the ability; אדישות (indifference) names the immunity (DECISIONS Q165)

ability:ABILITY_SHADOW_TAG.why: תג is the Gym badge in H&S (TERM_BADGE, the Johto badges תג משב and the rest), so תג צל read as a badge name; לכידת צל names the trap (DECISIONS Q165)

ability:ABILITY_EFFECT_SPORE.why: נבג אפקט is word for word and not Hebrew; ענן נבגים names the spores the ability releases on contact (DECISIONS Q165)

ability:ABILITY_HYPER_CUTTER.why: with על before the noun it read as the preposition, on a cutter; Hebrew writes super-X as X-על (DECISIONS Q165)

move:MOVE_FOCUS_ENERGY.why: a FireRed slip for H&S: after ב the imperative רכז reads as רַכָּז, 'השתמש ברכז אנרגיה' = used the energy coordinator; FOCUS is the noun ריכוז as in FOCUS PUNCH מכת ריכוז and FOCUS BLAST פיצוץ ריכוז (DECISIONS Q167)

move:MOVE_SUPERSONIC.why: a bare adjective does not read as a name (the owner's סטטי -> חשמל סטטי), and 'השתמש בעל-קולי' starts with the word בעל; the Japanese 超音波 is 'ultrasonic wave', and the game already says 'יוצר גל על-קולי' (DECISIONS Q167)

move:MOVE_TRANSFORM.why: an imperative used as a name: 'השתמש בשנה צורה' reads 'in a year, form'; the noun matches the party menu's שינוי צורה (DECISIONS Q167)

move:MOVE_KNOCK_OFF.why: bare הפלה reads as abortion or miscarriage, not a line for a child ('מאצ'וק השתמש בהפלה!'); the move swats the held item away, as the חבטת X names (DECISIONS Q167)

item:ITEM_BLACK_GLASSES.why: singular משקף is not the word for glasses and reads as the verb 'reflects'; the name takes the item's own plural row, משקפיים, as the משקפי family (משקפי בחירה, משקפי מגן) (DECISIONS Q168)

move:MOVE_BIND.why: עקידה is the Binding of Isaac, not a squeeze; the owner asked for a better name, and לפיתה is the tight grip the move is (DECISIONS Q173)

move:MOVE_METRONOME.why: פעמן is not a Hebrew word (a bell is פעמון); the owner asked for a better name, and מטרונום is the device the move is named after (DECISIONS Q173)

LTSURGE.why: the frontier and trade fields hold 7 bytes, so they use the short form on purpose (glossary notes); trainer names and dialogue keep the rank
